definite_bugs.title: Java source under package com.target is mistaken for build output
definite_bugs.symptom: JavaIndex.isMainSource sees /target/ in the package path com/target and excludes valid src/main/java files. The scanner then warns no Spring Boot app and emits zero services for this valid app.
definite_bugs.implementation_area: JavaIndex.isMainSource build-output filtering; the target directory check must distinguish a build output root from package path segments under src/main/java.
definite_bugs.minimal_repro: At commit 1cc04b0de3329adc0645b9dcaf967c8052925b37, scan the Gradle project containing src/main/java/com/target/devicemanager/DeviceMain.java (@SpringBootApplication line 25, SpringApplication.run line 36). The path segment target is part of the Java package, not a build output. The scanner should detect this app and its ScannerController endpoints (lines 26-45), including GET /v1/scan.
